nodes.title: START HERE — Installation and Verification
widgets_values:
YuE2 Setup

This optional workflow is a clean first-time installer and troubleshooting page. The Starter and Cover workflows contain the same combined installer/settings node, so you do not have to return here after setup.

Install

  1. Set target_root to a dedicated folder outside ComfyUI, for example E:\Yue2.
  2. Click Install Generation + Models for text-to-song only.
  3. Click Install Cover Tools + Models to add SheetSage2 source-song transcription.
  4. Or click Install Everything for both environments and all required models.
  5. Wait for the completion dialog. Large model downloads can take time.

Verify

Click Verify Existing Installation to check environments, CUDA support, dependencies, and model files without changing the installation. The report path appears in the completion dialog and ComfyUI console.

Important

  • The YuE2 and SheetSage2 Python environments are intentionally separate because their dependency versions differ.
  • Installation happens only when an install button is clicked. Merely queueing this node is passive.
  • Keep runtime_mode = isolated_process and backend = torch for the recommended fast, conflict-resistant setup.
  • After installation, use the same target_root in the Starter and Cover workflows.

Tip: Hover over every setting and installer button for details.
